name: encoding.pem
doc:
encoding.pem: PEM blocks (RFC 7468 / RFC 1421, Go's encoding/pem)
with optional "Key: Value" headers. crypto.x509 keeps its own
header-less PEM reader (x509.DecodePEM) for certificates.

items.name: Decode
items.doc:
Finds the first well-formed PEM block in text, Go-style: text before it
is skipped; on failure Block is nil and Rest is text.
items.summary: Finds the first well-formed PEM block in text, Go-style: text before it is skipped; on failure Block is nil and Rest is text.

items.name: DecodeAll
items.doc: Every block in text, in order (malformed ones are skipped).
items.summary: Every block in text, in order (malformed ones are skipped).

items.name: Encode
items.doc:
The PEM text of b: headers (sorted by key, Proc-Type first, as in Go),
a blank line if there are headers, base64 in 64-column lines.
items.summary: The PEM text of b: headers (sorted by key, Proc-Type first, as in Go), a blank line if there are headers, base64 in 64-column lines.

items.name: Block
items.doc: One block: -----BEGIN Type----- headers, base64 Bytes, -----END Type-----.
items.summary: One block: -----BEGIN Type----- headers, base64 Bytes, -----END Type-----.

members.name: Header
members.doc: The value of header key, or "".
members.summary: The value of header key, or "".

members.name: Block
members.doc: The first block, or nil if there is none (or it is malformed).
members.summary: The first block, or nil if there is none (or it is malformed).

members.name: Rest
members.doc: The text after that block (all of it when Block is nil).
members.summary: The text after that block (all of it when Block is nil).
